aim_text: Determine whether a user is eligible for a discount based on their account balance exceeding a threshold.
contract: Returns True only when balance is strictly greater than threshold. A balance equal to the threshold is not eligible.

callee.bug_rationale: The comparison operator is wrong: it uses b < t instead of b > t, causing True to be returned when the balance is less than the threshold.

correct.purpose: computes the discount amount a customer receives based on their balance

violating.purpose: turns a list of (balance, threshold) account pairs into a list of discount eligibility flags
violating.violation: The contract expects is_discount_eligible(balance, threshold) with balance first and threshold second; this caller swaps the argument order to is_discount_eligible(threshold, balance), reversing the comparison direction for each record.

review.note: violation plausible and grounded in the judge-facing spec; sandbox outcome matches truth
